$comment: Type aliases the Web Awesome CEM uses for attributes but that no .d.ts of the release declares, because they come from another package. Export-WaApiSurface.ps1 resolves them into the attribute's 'resolvedType'. Only members expressible as an HTML attribute value are listed (object forms are dropped). Re-verify every upgrade against the cited source; a new external alias stays unresolved (and fails the enum parity checks) until it is added here.

PlaybackDirection.source: TypeScript lib.dom.d.ts (Web Animations API KeyframeEffect direction); wa-animation passes the attribute to Element.animate()

FillMode.source: TypeScript lib.dom.d.ts (Web Animations API KeyframeEffect fill); wa-animation passes the attribute to Element.animate()

ChartType.source: chart.js 4 keyof ChartTypeRegistry; the controller ids registered by the Chart.js v4.5.1 bundled in the 3.12.0 dist-cdn, and the valid types listed by the chart.d.ts JSDoc of wa-chart

LayoutPosition.source: chart.js 4 LayoutPosition (the {[scaleId: string]: number} object form is not expressible as an attribute and is dropped)
